fusions.name: Levelling Blow
fusions.desc: A flattening blow that deals 30 damage, ignores armour and leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Mallet Toss
fusions.desc: Hurls a mallet that deals 13 damage to the first enemy it meets and knocks it back 3 tiles. Its reach is 40% longer.

fusions.name: Heavy Hand
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 30% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Softened Mark
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying a condition, you deal 12% more damage.
